messages.subject: Letter of Claim - Harrow Precision Engineering v Melbourne Sealtech
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Selby,

We understand you act for Melbourne Sealtech Limited. Please find attached our letter of claim under the Pre-Action Protocol for Construction and Engineering Disputes. We should be grateful for acknowledgement within 14 days and a substantive response within 28 days.

Yours faithfully,
Tom Gallagher

Tom Gallagher
Associate, Dispute Resolution
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ

messages.subject: RE: Letter of Claim - Harrow Precision Engineering v Melbourne Sealtech
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Gallagher,

We acknowledge receipt of your letter of claim dated 14 April 2025 on behalf of Melbourne Sealtech Limited. We will respond substantively within the protocol period. Our client's position is that liability is denied, but we will set that out in full in due course.

Yours faithfully,
Adam Selby
Partner
Denham Lewis LLP
